name: testis expressed 12

function.text: TEX12 encodes testis-expressed protein 12. It participates in homologous recombination and reciprocal meiotic recombination.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: TEX12 encodes testis-expressed protein 12. Based in part on similarity, it forms part of the transverse central element of synaptonemal complexes (SCS), formed between homologous chromosomes during meiotic prophase. It requires SYCP1 in order to be incorporated into the central element.
